## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a37cae1fc8b6a9f147707f0e3777bf7f43c464bc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/hexBadgePalette.ts, ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/badge-hex-fidelity-5141.test.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.linkEllipsis-12523.test.tsx + ui/packages/fields/package.json (the `exports` map), ui/packages/fields/vite.config.ts (the lib entry), ui/packages/fields/README.md, skills/objectui/rules/styling.md (the taught faces), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/file-affordance.tsx (JSDoc naming `UrlCellRenderer`), ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.fabricatedValue-8490.test.tsx (the existing `getCellRenderer('url')` pin), ui/packages/fields/CHANGELOG.md line 5530

Reviewed at 2026-11-08T03:40Z on the narrowing face, read-only: card #25921 (body and all 141 comments, claim 6716009586 and amendment 6716064637 included), PR #31352's body and file list, the diff of `a37cae1f` against its merge base `604a2b3b`, the check-runs on the head, and the cited code on `origin/main` (`dc7f5c4b` at review time) read through `git grep` / `git show` on fetched objects. No checkout, worktree, build, test, gate or ablation was run; `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template` was run only for this record's shape. Every absence claim below is the reviewer's own measurement, not the PR body's.

### ① Derived judgments

Check-runs on `a37cae1f` at 2026-11-08T03:37Z: 53 runs, 20 success, 11 skipped, 22 in progress, 0 failure or neutral. Completed and green: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint UI, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, Auto Label, filter. Still running: Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus. The gate verdicts are theirs; nothing below re-runs one.

1. **Public surface: the `@object-ui/fields` root entry stops publishing `deriveHexBadgePalette` (value), `HexBadgePalette` (type) and `UrlCellRenderer` (value); nothing else leaves and nothing is added.** Right. Index.tsx at the head has 0 mentions of `HexBadgePalette`, 4 of `deriveHexBadgePalette` (one import, one pointer comment, two call sites) and `UrlCellRenderer` only as a local `function` plus the standard-map line (`url: UrlCellRenderer`, line 4152). The held-out names `ColorSwatchCellRenderer`, `LocationCellRenderer`, `AddressCellRenderer`, `EmailCellRenderer`, `PhoneCellRenderer` are still `export function` at the head, as amendment 6716064637 requires.

2. **Zero consumers outside the package, prose included.** Right, measured here. `git grep -w` on objectstack `origin/main` for each of the three names hits only `ui/packages/fields/` (index.tsx; the 5141 and 12523 tests; CHANGELOG.md line 5530; the JSDoc at `widgets/file-affordance.tsx:134`; the comment table in the 8490 test). A substring grep (no `-w`) outside `ui/packages/fields/` returns nothing. hotcrm `origin/main` (`6961ab1`): 0 hits for all three, as a word and as a substring, in the index and in the working tree. Nothing under `skills/**`, `content/**` or `docs/**` names them. Positive controls in the same module, files outside the package on `origin/main`: `getBadgeHexAppearance` 14, `getBadgeColorClasses` 13, `EmailCellRenderer` 4, `PhoneCellRenderer` 3, so the census tool finds what exists.

3. **The move is behaviour-preserving.** Right. The 182-line span from `BADGE_TEXT_CONTRAST` through the closing brace of `deriveHexBadgePalette` on `main` and the same span in the new `hexBadgePalette.ts` differ in exactly two comment lines (the `DOT_CONTRAST_FLOOR` note now reads "`DOT_COLOR_MAP` (in `index.tsx`)", and `DOT_COLOR_MAP` is indeed still in index.tsx, 3 mentions); every executable line is byte-identical. The new module has no import statement at all, so it is a leaf and index.tsx importing it (`./hexBadgePalette.js`, the package's nodenext spelling) creates no cycle. Every helper of the span (`Rgb`, `clampNum`, `parseHexColor`, `rgbToHsl`, `hslToRgb`, `rgbToHex`, `relativeLuminance`, `contrastRatio`, `readableOnSurface`, the two floors, the two surfaces) is now mentioned 0 times in index.tsx: nothing dangles and nothing was read from outside the span. `getBadgeHexAppearance`, `getDotHexAppearance`, `HexColorAppearance` and the two Tailwind class strings stay in index.tsx unchanged.

4. **`UrlCellRenderer` loses `export` in place and stays the `url` renderer.** Right. Its body is unchanged; it reads `EmptyValue`, `coerceToSafeValue`, `isBlankCellText`, `isPlainObjectValue`, `TruncatedText` and `Button` from the entry's own scope, so dropping the keyword rather than moving it is the right call. `registerFieldRenderer('url', …)` appears nowhere in the repo, so `getCellRenderer('url')` falls through to the standard map and serves this function. `url` is not a retired spelling, so the `reportRetiredFieldType` branch on that read path is silent.

5. **No subpath or other module reaches the three names.** Right. `package.json` `exports` has only `.` and `./style.css`; the lib entry is `src/index.tsx` alone; none of the entry's `export *` / `export { } from` lines points at `hexBadgePalette.js`; `widgets/UrlField.tsx` exports only `UrlField`. The `dist/hexBadgePalette.d.ts` the dts plugin will emit is unreachable through the exports map. No kept export's declaration names a retired name (`HexColorAppearance` is `{ className, style }`).

6. **Test edits weaken no pin.** Right. `badge-hex-fidelity-5141.test.tsx` changes one import line only; all 12 call sites and every assertion stand. `cellRenderers.linkEllipsis-12523.test.tsx` binds `const UrlCellRenderer = getCellRenderer('url')` and keeps every assertion (tag `A`, `href`, `inline-block max-w-full truncate align-top`, not `inline-flex`); if `url` ever left the standard map the fallback `TextCellRenderer` renders no anchor and the pin fails loudly, so the pin now guards the face a consumer actually reaches, as the 8490 pin already does. The extensionless `'../hexBadgePalette'` import matches the sibling-import convention of the other fields tests under `tsconfig.test.json` (bundler resolution).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/25921-fields-hex-palette-url-renderer.md`: `'@object-ui/fields': patch`, title `refactor(fields)!: …`, **BREAKING** banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, both lines also on the PR body. Right: under the 2026-10-21 ruling the level follows the metadata protocol alone, and this diff moves no authorable key or value, so `patch` with the `!` and the banner as the breaking-ness carriers is the level this series has used in every landed `25921-*` changeset. No `major`, no `skip-changeset`. The ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/fields#deriveHexBadgePalette, @object-ui/fields#HexBadgePalette, @object-ui/fields#UrlCellRenderer)` names three operands; the body carries exactly three `- FROM \`name\` TO …` lines, one canonical backticked operand each, 1:1 with the marker, and every TO side names an export that stays (`getBadgeHexAppearance`, `getDotHexAppearance`, `HexColorAppearance`, `getCellRenderer`). The prose names the kept neighbours and says the code stays in the package, which the tree confirms. Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` is the right arm: an entry narrows, no spec surface moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6716752607: `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`. Deviations, each answered: no assignees and no labels on `pr_create` (the order and AGENTS.md say none; process, not tree); the shared checkout detached so the worktree could hold the branch (process, not tree); the reworded `DOT_CONTRAST_FLOOR` comment line is longer than its neighbours (cosmetic; the ui ESLint config carries no `max-len` rule and `Lint · ESLint` and `Lint UI` are green). `out_of_scope_findings` records `ColorSwatchCellRenderer` (README-taught), `LocationCellRenderer` and `AddressCellRenderer` (named by prose in `plugin-detail/src/emptiness.ts`) as staying on the card, which matches amendment 6716064637 and the tree. The PR body's "external npm hosts 未实测" is the series-wide caveat the BREAKING banner carries. Nothing escalates.

### ④ Design judgment

The published spec on `main` for this surface is the fields README (which teaches `getCellRenderer`, `resolveCellRendererType`, `registerFieldRenderer`, and names `ColorSwatchCellRenderer` as a shipped type) and `skills/objectui/rules/styling.md` line 131, whose worked reference for author-declared colour is `getBadgeHexAppearance` / `getDotHexAppearance`. Neither teaches `deriveHexBadgePalette`, `HexBadgePalette` or `UrlCellRenderer`; the palette pair is the implementation beneath the taught reference, and the url renderer is reachable through the registry face every list and detail view uses. The narrowing therefore takes no declared capability away at the consumer; it makes the entry say what the spec already says.

Attempts to break it:

- A host that wants to wrap the stock url renderer under `url` must read `getCellRenderer('url')` before calling `registerFieldRenderer('url', …)`, because the registry wins on the read path afterwards. That ordering is the same one the README's `registerFieldRenderer('api_token', getCellRenderer('password'))` pattern already relies on, and the changeset's TO line states the registry behaviour. `EmailCellRenderer` and `PhoneCellRenderer` stay exported by name only because they have consumers; the asymmetry is the census rule, not a gap. Not a finding.
- A deep import of the new module (`@object-ui/fields/dist/hexBadgePalette`) is refused by the `exports` map. Not a finding.
- CHANGELOG.md line 5530 and the `file-affordance.tsx` JSDoc name `UrlCellRenderer`; both describe a function that still exists under that name, so both stay true. Not a finding.
- The 5141 fidelity test now reaches the palette through an internal module path rather than the entry. That is the correct face for an internal helper and keeps the contrast pins alive; a consumer-facing pin on the same behaviour already exists through `getBadgeHexAppearance` in the same file. Not a finding.

Findings:

- **should-fix (cosmetic, non-blocking):** in `index.tsx` the new `import { deriveHexBadgePalette } from './hexBadgePalette.js'` (line 30) is inserted between the `address-format` import and the comment "The same arrangement for numbers …", which refers back to the address-format comment above it; the import now splits that comment pair. Move the import one line down (after the `number-format` import) or above the address-format comment. No behaviour or type effect.

No must-fix.
